title: Install configuration
description: The shape of ak.install.yaml, the local and uncommitted file at the tree root that says which adapters one install attaches. `ak build` and `ak validate` read it; a `git archive` extract never carries it, so a figure measured there is the default's. Absent, every adapter whose contract states a capability it supplies and fails closed on is attached, which is the default ruling `fail-closed-adapter-lifts-ceiling` sets. Present, exactly the listed adapters are attached, and `attached: []` is the host alone. This schema states shape. Which ids an install may attach is read out of each adapter contract's §1 by src/packaging/install.ts (`loadAdapterSupplies`), and restating that list here would be a copy that parts from the contracts the first time one of them gains a row.

attached.description: The adapters this install attaches, by catalog id. An adapter attached here lifts a skill's mode ceiling for the capabilities its contract supplies and fails closed on; one left out caps every skill requiring them at `guided`, reported as `packaging.mode-capped`. An empty list is legal and meaningful: it is the host alone, as `adapters/claude-code/CONTRACT.md` §3 states it.
